own_solution.law: Snell's law at the end face plus total internal reflection at core-cladding: n0 sin(theta_max) = sqrt(n_core^2 - n_clad^2)

notes: NA = sqrt(1.5^2 - 1.44^2) = sqrt(0.1764) = 0.42; theta = asin(0.42) = 24.83 deg. With n0 = 1.2: sin(theta) = 0.35, theta = 20.49 deg. Liquid in the trough beside the fibre has no optical path to the end face. 'Earlier experiment only' sentences leave the current outside medium as air. T5FB3/T38EB carry no number ('well known') unlike their 1.2 counterparts; acceptable as numeral-free distractors.
